core_progression_principle: Scientific Discovery IS the Tech Tree — Acyclic Branching Progression DAG where every Tier-N hazard biome has an explicit safe ecotone or natural-window entry path so players NEVER hit a circular unlock deadlock.
ending_world_state_axes: ecological_conduct (non-invasive observation & Keystone communions vs. destructive harvesting/hunting)
forensic_truth (Surveyor-01 wreckage & Kaelen Voss 7-cache investigation depth)
caldera_resolution (Reactor Overdrive extraction vs. Bio-Remediation healing & open-band vs. silenced relay)

milestones.title: Salvage Drop-Pod & Field Lab Boot
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Tier-1 Rimlands have breathable air; Twin-Moon Low Tide exposes Drift-Wreck Cove salvage safely.

milestones.title: Relay Node 1 (Rimlands) & Bio-Membrane Filter Mk1
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Breath-Sponge Lichen and Lichen-Back Newts inhabit the safe wet Singing Canopy / Fen Ecotone border AND midday sun briefly lifts low Acid Mist.

milestones.title: Basin Ecology, Acoustic Stealth & Relay Node 2 (Caverns)
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Bio-Membrane Filter Mk1 protects Mara in Vitreous Fen, Vesper Jungle, and upper Mycelial Caverns; Echo-Bat pings map dark passages safely.

milestones.title: Buoyancy Skiff & Tidal Lagoon Survey (Optional Parallel Branch)
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Basalt Terraces require zero special suit (wind & predators only); Float-Bladder Rafts grow along Archipelago shores allowing Skiff crafting BEFORE entering deep Tidal Lagoon basins, which drain at Twin-Moon Low Tide.

milestones.title: Twilight Desert Crossing & Thermal Lining (Optional Parallel Branch)
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Ochre Badlands is safely traversable during Dusk, Night, and Dawn (or inside Glass-Skink canyon shade) without a Thermal Suit — earning Mirage Wax-Barrel & Copper-Bloom to craft permanent thermal protection!

milestones.title: Arc-Grounded Suit & Relay Node 3 (Resonant Quartz Peaks)
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Thermal Lining resists alpine chill; sheltering beside Grounding Storm-Ferns during Ion Tempests allows harvesting Capacitor Ore to craft the permanent Arc-Grounded Suit!

milestones.title: The Polar Superconductor & Caldera Resolution
milestones.safe_entry_mechanism: Thermal Lining + Geothermal Oases (guided by Rime-Puff Burrowers) allow Cryo-Glacier exploration; walking in the steam-shadow of the Cinder-Back Tortoise permits reaching Surveyor-01 Wreck Core inside Caldera radiation.
